body:
> It also seems generally agreed upon that .csproj and .sln files should be kept in code versioning: https://stackoverflow.com/a/65400320/2037431

They are talking about general C# project , NOT UNITY!

Also, the project generation depends on individual preference, which is not shared by git.

So I think we should not share these files.

Since Unity auto generates C# project files, possibly based on user configuration and/or other context-dependent values (OS, version, and so on) it does make sense to not keep these in the repo for a Unity project.
